description: Curated, government-aligned knowledge base of NSQF vocational roles and pathways. This dataset is based on publicly available Qualification Pack (QP) documents published by Sector Skill Councils (SSCs) and listed on the National Qualification Register (NQR). It does NOT claim to be a live government database and should not be treated as one. All NSQF levels, QP codes, and eligibility details are drawn from official sources as referenced in each entry.

roles.title: Sewing Machine Operator
roles.eligibility: 8th grade pass preferred; no prior formal training required
roles.qualification: Certificate in Sewing Machine Operator — Apparel, Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)
roles.duration: Not specified in source (PMKVY short-term training format)
roles.description: Operates industrial sewing machines to stitch fabric, fur, or synthetic materials to produce apparel or made-up items. Suitable for home tailors or those with basic sewing experience seeking industrial employment or self-employment.

source.organization: Apparel, Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)

roles.title: Self-Employed Tailor
roles.eligibility: 8th grade pass with 6 months of relevant experience in tailoring or sewing
roles.qualification: Certificate in Self-Employed Tailor — Apparel, Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)
roles.duration: Not specified in source (PMKVY short-term training format)
roles.description: Designed for home-based or self-employed tailors who stitch, alter, and repair garments for customers. Covers end-to-end garment construction including measurement, cutting, stitching, and finishing. Ideal for individuals with tailoring experience seeking formal certification and skill upgradation.

source.organization: Apparel, Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)

roles.title: Inline Checker — Sewing
roles.eligibility: 10th grade pass with 1.5 years of relevant experience; or 8th grade pass with 4.5 years of relevant experience; or NSQF Level 2.5 qualification with 3 years of relevant experience
roles.qualification: Certificate in Inline Checker — Sewing — Apparel, Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)
roles.description: Responsible for conducting quality checks on garment production lines at various stages of the sewing process. Identifies defects, ensures adherence to quality standards, and coordinates with production team. Suitable for experienced sewers seeking to move into quality assurance roles.

source.organization: Apparel, Made-Ups & Home Furnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)

roles.title: Two Shaft Handloom Weaver
roles.qualification: Certificate in Two Shaft Handloom Weaver — Textile Sector Skill Council (TSC)
roles.description: Covers operation of a two-shaft handloom to produce traditional or commercial textiles. Relevant for weavers in handloom clusters seeking to formalise skills. Supports self-employment and artisan livelihoods.

source.document: Qualification Pack: Two Shaft Handloom Weaver (TSC/Q7303)

roles.title: Paddy Cultivator
roles.eligibility: 10th grade pass (no experience required); 8th grade pass with 3 years in agriculture; 5th grade pass with 6 years in agriculture; or NSQF Level 2.5 with 1.5 years in agriculture
roles.qualification: Certificate in Paddy Cultivator — Agriculture Skill Council of India (ASCI)
roles.duration: 270 notional hours (90 hours theory + 150 hours practical + 30 hours employability skills)
roles.description: Trains individuals in systematic paddy/rice cultivation covering land preparation, seed selection, nursery management, transplanting, irrigation, pest control, and post-harvest handling. Relevant for agricultural laborers, tenant farmers, and rural youth seeking to improve crop productivity and income.

roles.title: Organic Grower
roles.eligibility: 5th grade pass or above; PMKVY RPL candidates require prior farming experience
roles.qualification: Certificate in Organic Grower — Agriculture Skill Council of India (ASCI)
roles.description: Equips farmers and agricultural workers with techniques for organic crop production including soil preparation, composting, bio-input preparation, natural pest management, and record keeping for organic certification. Supports farmers seeking premium markets and sustainable livelihoods.

roles.title: Pulses Cultivator
roles.eligibility: Not specified in source; consistent with ASCI NSQF Level 3 entry norms
roles.qualification: Certificate in Pulses Cultivator — Agriculture Skill Council of India (ASCI)
roles.description: Focuses on systematic cultivation of pulses (lentils, chickpeas, moong, urad, etc.) including agronomy, soil preparation, pest management, and post-harvest handling. Relevant for dry-land farmers and agricultural laborers in pulse-growing regions.

roles.title: Assistant Carpenter
roles.qualification: Certificate in Assistant Carpenter — Furniture & Fittings Skill Council (FFSC)
roles.description: Entry-level carpentry role covering basic woodworking, hand tool operation, wood cutting, shaping, surface finishing, and assisting senior carpenters in furniture fabrication and installation. Suitable for individuals with no prior formal training seeking employment in the furniture manufacturing or construction sector.

roles.title: Carpenter
roles.eligibility: Relevant industry experience required (approximately 4 years); foundational carpentry knowledge required
roles.qualification: Certificate in Carpenter — Furniture & Fittings Skill Council (FFSC)
roles.duration: Approximately 720 notional hours (for specialised streams including theory, practical, and OJT)
roles.description: Professional-level carpentry qualification covering fabrication, assembly, and installation of wooden furniture, doors, windows, and kitchen cabinets. Suitable for experienced carpenters seeking formal certification and advancement to supervisory or entrepreneurial roles.

roles.title: Assistant Shuttering Carpenter
roles.qualification: Certificate in Assistant Shuttering Carpenter — Construction Skill Development Council of India (CSDCI)
roles.description: Covers preparation, assembly, and dismantling of wooden formwork (shutters) for Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) structures at construction sites. Entry-level role suited for individuals seeking employment in the construction sector with basic woodworking background.

source.organization: Construction Skill Development Council of India (CSDCI)

roles.title: Plumber (General)
roles.qualification: Certificate in Plumber (General) — Water Management & Plumbing Skill Council (WMPSC)
roles.description: Professional plumbing qualification covering domestic and commercial plumbing installation, maintenance, and repair. Includes water supply systems, drainage, sanitary ware installation, and basic troubleshooting. In high demand across urban and semi-urban construction markets.

roles.title: Retail Sales Assistant
roles.qualification: Certificate in Retail Sales Assistant — Retailers Association's Skill Council of India (RASCI)
roles.description: Equips individuals with skills for front-end retail operations including customer service, product demonstrations, billing, and inventory basics. Suitable for those seeking employment in organised retail stores, supermarkets, or standalone shops.

source.organization: Retailers Association's Skill Council of India (RASCI)

roles.title: Carpet Weaver
roles.qualification: Certificate in Carpet Weaver — Handicrafts and Carpet Sector Skill Council (HCSSC)
roles.description: Covers traditional hand-knotted and tufted carpet weaving techniques including loom setup, knotting methods, pattern following, and quality inspection. Relevant for artisans in carpet-weaving clusters in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jammu & Kashmir, and other regions.

source.organization: Handicrafts and Carpet Sector Skill Council (HCSSC)

roles.title: Jute Handloom Weaver
roles.qualification: Certificate in Jute Handloom Weaver — Handicrafts and Carpet Sector Skill Council (HCSSC)
roles.description: Focuses on jute handloom weaving techniques for producing bags, home furnishing items, and decorative products. Relevant for artisans in jute-producing regions (West Bengal, Bihar, Assam, Odisha) seeking to formalise skills and access better markets.

source.organization: Handicrafts and Carpet Sector Skill Council (HCSSC)

roles.title: Domestic Data Entry Operator
roles.qualification: Certificate in Domestic Data Entry Operator — IT-ITeS Sector Skills Council NASSCOM
roles.duration: Approximately 400–440 notional hours (100 hours theory + 300 hours practical; some versions include 40 hours for employability/entrepreneurship skills)
roles.description: Trains individuals to enter, update, verify, and retrieve data using computers, office software, and databases. Covers basic computer operation, typing proficiency, MS Office, and BPO/data-processing fundamentals. Entry point for IT-enabled service sector employment.

source.document: Qualification Pack: Domestic Data Entry Operator (SSC/Q2212)

roles.title: Social Media Executive
roles.qualification: Certificate in Social Media Executive — Media and Entertainment Skills Council (MESC)
roles.description: Covers the skills required to manage social media accounts, create content, execute digital campaigns, and track basic analytics. Highly relevant for self-employed artisans, small business owners, and entrepreneurs seeking to market products online or support businesses with digital presence.

roles.title: Social Media Manager
roles.eligibility: Postgraduate degree; or graduate degree with 1–2 years of relevant experience; or diploma with 2 years of experience; or Social Media Executive (NSQF Level 4) certification with 3 years of experience
roles.qualification: Certificate in Social Media Manager — Media and Entertainment Skills Council (MESC)
roles.description: Advanced digital qualification for managing social media strategy, leading campaigns, overseeing teams, and preparing analytics reports for organisations or as a freelancer/consultant. Career progression from Social Media Executive (Level 4).

roles.title: Assistant Beauty Therapist
roles.qualification: Certificate in Assistant Beauty Therapist — Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council (B&WSSC)
roles.description: Entry-level beauty and wellness qualification covering skin care services, hair removal, basic makeup, manicure, pedicure, and salon work area maintenance. Suitable for individuals seeking employment or self-employment in beauty parlours and salons.

roles.title: Hair Dresser and Stylist
roles.qualification: Certificate in Hair Dresser and Stylist — Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council (B&WSSC)
roles.description: Professional hairdressing qualification covering advanced hair care services including cutting, colouring, perming, straightening, and client consultation. Enables employment in salons or self-employment as a freelance stylist or salon owner.

source.document: Qualification Pack: Hair Dresser and Stylist (BWS/Q0202)

roles.title: Food Products Packaging Technician
roles.eligibility: 10th grade pass or 8th grade pass with relevant industry experience
roles.qualification: Certificate in Food Products Packaging Technician — Food Industry Capacity & Skill Initiative (FICSI)
roles.description: Covers food packaging operations including machine operation, quality checking, labelling, and food safety compliance. Suitable for individuals seeking employment in food processing units, packaged food companies, or FMCG sector. Aligned with FSSAI and food safety standards.

source.document: Qualification Pack: Food Products Packaging Technician (FIC/Q7001)
